name: read_input
source: program p; var f:text; s:string[64]; begin assign(f,'input.txt'); reset(f); while not eof(f) do begin readln(f,s); writeln(s) end; close(f) end.

name: rewrite_input
source: program p; var f:text; s:string; begin assign(f,'input.txt'); reset(f); readln(f,s); close(f); writeln(s); rewrite(f); writeln(f,'changed'); close(f) end.

name: empty_files
source: program p; var f,g:text; begin assign(f,'empty.txt'); reset(f); writeln(eof(f)); close(f); assign(g,'out.txt'); rewrite(g); close(g) end.

name: exact_bytes
source: program p; var f:text; begin assign(f,'out.txt'); rewrite(f); write(f,#65279,'é',#0,#13,#10,#8,#27,#128512); close(f) end.

name: typed_not_exported
source: program p; var f:file of integer; begin assign(f,'numbers'); rewrite(f); write(f,42); close(f) end.

name: error_discards
source: program p; var f:text; n:integer; begin assign(f,'out.txt'); rewrite(f); write(f,'partial'); n:=1 div 0 end.

name: input_budget
source: program p; var f:text; begin assign(f,'out.txt'); rewrite(f); write(f,'x') end.

name: empty_output_at_budget
source: program p; var f:text; begin assign(f,'out.txt'); rewrite(f); close(f) end.

name: live_copy
source: program p; var f,g:text; s:string; begin assign(f,'input.txt'); reset(f); readln(f,s); close(f); write('Suffix: '); assign(g,'out.txt'); rewrite(g); write(g,s); readln(s); writeln(g,s); close(g) end.

name: unsafe_name
source: program p; var f:text; begin assign(f,'../'+ #10 +'.txt'); rewrite(f); write(f,'safe'); close(f) end.
